slice.integration_reason: Current ACTIVE_WAVE is immutable and sealed awaiting comparator outputs bound to its exact wave, selection snapshot, and source-set identity. This bounded verification established the current wave integrity and snapshot commit reachability but did not establish an admissible exact-bound comparator handoff; unrelated comparator artifacts were not integrated.

completion_semantics: This verification/no-change is one bounded Phase-1 slice and is not Phase-1 or global completion.
continuation: On the next invocation, reread the current control plane and ACTIVE_WAVE. If this same sealed wave remains current, verify whether an exact comparator handoff bound to its wave, selection snapshot, and source-set identity is present and admissible; if so, execute only the smallest authorized atomic integration/index/feed/readback chain and independently recompute candidate_set_digest and evidence membership before integration. Otherwise record one bounded verification result and keep the recurring Phase-1 continuation open.
